_comment: Guided tour of Settings > Fonts. 'name' is a field's attr, a button's action, or 'preview.<role>' for a sample line. Steps with 'await' wait for the user to use the control.

steps.title: One size for the whole window
steps.text: Size sets the interface text: buttons, labels, tables, menus. Headings, captions and code follow it unless you give them a size of their own. Step it up with the arrows or type a value and press Enter -- the window redraws at once, and the sample line below shows the result.

steps.title: Magnify everything
steps.text: Magnification scales the whole window -- text, spacing, icons and plots together -- the way a browser zoom does. Use it when the window is right but small on a large or distant screen; use Size when only the text should grow.

steps.title: The editor and the console
steps.text: Pick a Face for code. Only monospaced families are listed, because the editor lines its columns up on a fixed character width. The sample below is drawn in the new face as soon as you pick it.

steps.title: Reading the documentation
steps.text: Text size sets the running text of the Documentation dock and the help windows; headings and captions keep their steps above and below it. Open the Documentation dock beside this one to watch a real page change.

steps.title: Back to the shipped look
steps.text: Reset to defaults returns every font setting to the shipped look, applies it and saves it. Every change you make here is saved as you make it, so there is no separate Save.
